assembly_steps.title: Step 1 — Place Trunk Base (#1), Mount Rear 12V DC Barrel Jack (J1) & Insert N20 Motor Into Shroud Tower
assembly_steps.subtitle: 1a) Mount 5.5×2.1mm DC Barrel Jack (J1) in rear -X Ø11.40mm port → 1b) Slide 12V 150RPM N20 Motor (Option B) or 6V LA002 (Option A) up into Ø28.0 mm Shroud Tower
hardware: 1a. Place Bark-Textured Trunk_Base (#1, Ø185mm diagonal root footprint, Ø135×50mm Hollow Root Vault) flat on build surface and thread the 5.5×2.1mm DC Barrel Jack (J1, DC-099) into the rear -X Ø11.40 mm port (Z = 10.0 mm)

1b. Slide the 12V 150rpm N20 Gear Motor (Option B primary drop-in, or 6V LA002 for Option A) + Servo_Or_030_Adapter up into the central Ø28.0 mm Isolated Motor Shroud Tower (D-shaft pointing up through Z=27.2 mm roof bore)
1c. Route the 2-wire motor lead out the bottom -Y shroud wire exit notch (6.5×7.6 mm) so loose cables in the vault can never rub against the spinning clutch or auger
assembly_steps.clearance_note: The central Ø28.0 mm Isolated Motor & Clutch Shroud Tower physically walls off the spinning N20 motor and coupler from the >150 cm³ open Cable Slack Dump Zone.

assembly_steps.title: Step 2 — Install 12V→5V Buck Converter, WAGO 221 Lever Nuts & M5Stack (A092 + C008) in Root Vault
assembly_steps.subtitle: 2a) Seat A092+C008 & 12V→5V 5A Buck in vault cradles → 2b) Wire WAGO-1..4 with inline fuses (cap Grove Red +5V!) → 2c) Close Battery_Cover & Base_Bottom_Cover
hardware: 2a. Seat M5Stack ATOM Lite (C008) + Atomic H-Driver Base (A092) into the -Y cradle (powered from WAGO-1 +12V_BUS via 2A fuse F1 into VIN/GND; A092's internal buck powers C008 with zero USB cable needed) and seat the 12V→5.0V 5A screw-terminal Buck Converter into the +X cradle (fed via 3A fuse F2)

2b. Clamp the 12V 150RPM N20 Motor leads into A092 M1/M2 (or wire Option A 12V→6V buck + H-bridge for 6V LA002), plug the A096 Grove2Dupont cable into C008 (leave A096 Red +5V wire CAPPED in an empty WAGO port to prevent 5V backfeeding!), and connect the 5V Buck output (+ 1000µF cap) to WAGO-3 (+5V_LED) & WAGO-4 (GND_LED)

2c. Secure Battery_Cover and snap on Base_Bottom_Cover (3.0 mm thick with ventilation louvers, 4× captive-magnet tabs, and an upward Ø23.60×2.8 mm Snap-In Hollow Retaining Ring that clicks concentrically into Trunk_Base's central Ø24.00 mm shroud bore with zero screws needed!)
assembly_steps.clearance_note: With >150 cm³ of unobstructed perimeter volume inside the Ø135×50 mm Hollow Root Vault and >= 18 mm finger gap around every cradle, WAGO 221 lever nuts and inline fuse holders fit cleanly with zero soldering.

assembly_steps.title: Step 3 — Press Gold Hex Coupler (Motor_Clutch_Driver) Onto N20 Motor D-Shaft
assembly_steps.subtitle: Lower Motor_Clutch_Driver straight down through the Trunk_Base bore onto the N20 motor's D-shaft at Z = 26.2 mm
hardware: 3a. Align the flat inside Motor_Clutch_Driver's bottom D-bore with the flat on the LA002 N20 motor shaft
3b. Press down firmly until seated at Z = 26.2 mm with its 4.85 mm AF male hex peg pointing straight up
assembly_steps.clearance_note: Direct positive hex drive eliminates magnet slippage while allowing the auger to lift straight out from above.

assembly_steps.title: Step 4 — Couple Two-Piece Archimedes Auger (#1 Lower + #2 Upper)
assembly_steps.subtitle: 4a) Lower auger_lower (#1) onto the Gold Hex Coupler → 4b) Press auger_upper (#2) onto auger_lower's top hex peg (engraved '1')
hardware: 4a. Lower auger_lower (#1) into Trunk_Base so its bottom 5.15 mm AF female hex socket slides over Motor_Clutch_Driver's hex peg
4b. Align auger_upper (#2, engraved '2' on top shaft) with auger_lower's top male hex peg (engraved '1') and press together (hiding '1')
assembly_steps.clearance_note: The phase-matched helical flight is continuous across the Z = 222.7 mm hex joint with 1.50 mm radial clearance inside the trunk bore.

assembly_steps.title: Step 5 — Stack Bark-Textured Trunk Middle (#2) & Trunk Top (#3)
assembly_steps.subtitle: 5a) Lower trunk_mid (#2) over the auger onto trunk_base (#1) → 5b) Lower trunk_top (#3) onto trunk_mid (#2)
hardware: 5a. Slide trunk_mid (#2) down over the auger and seat onto trunk_base's keyed tenon (engraved '1' at Z = 150 mm becomes 100% hidden)
5b. Slide trunk_top (#3, with its upward Ø59.4×4.0 mm Crown Centering Tenon Collar) down onto trunk_mid's keyed tenon (engraved '2' at Z = 300 mm becomes 100% hidden)
assembly_steps.clearance_note: The keyed tenon flats automatically align the internal Ø 26.6 mm (-Y) vertical ball flute, gothic viewing windows, and the oversized 10.0×8.0 mm rear (-X) Connector-Pass-Through wiring conduit.

assembly_steps.title: Step 6 — Slide In All 24 Exact-Radius Cantilever Brackets (#1 at 60° → #24 at 1440°)
assembly_steps.subtitle: Sort Plates 3 & 4's 24 brackets by their engraved top-saddle number (1 to 24) and slide each dovetail tenon down into its 60° trunk socket
hardware: 6a. Lower 6 Stations (#1–#6 on Plate 3, engraved '1'..'6' on the top saddle floor): slide into the lowest 6 trunk dovetail sockets (60°–360°, radii 141.9 mm down to 126.1 mm)

6b. Middle 12 Stations (#7–#12 on Plate 3 & #13–#18 on Plate 4, engraved '7'..'18'): slide in ascending spiral order into the middle trunk sockets (420°–1080°, radii 123.0 mm down to 88.3 mm, including the precision cross-seam dovetails at Z = 150 mm and Z = 300 mm)
6c. Upper 6 Stations (#19–#24 on Plate 4, engraved '19'..'24'): slide into the highest 6 trunk sockets (1140°–1440°, radii 85.2 mm down to 69.4 mm)
assembly_steps.clearance_note: Every single bracket (#1–#12 on Plate 3, #13–#24 on Plate 4) is custom-sized to the exact conical helix radius at its 60° station and prints upright on Z=0 with a flat bottom rib (zero supports!).

assembly_steps.title: Step 7 — Snap Together Helical Track Segments 01 → 14 (Built-In Male/Female Tenons + Seam Brackets)
assembly_steps.subtitle: Slide each segment's downhill Female Sockets onto the previous segment's Twin Ø3.8mm Male Snap-Lock Tenon Pegs + Sidewall Tongues and click onto the 24 Bracket Pegs
hardware: 7a. Dock track_seg_01's bottom return ramp into Trunk_Base's -Y intake port (Z = 50 mm) and click its underside sockets onto the Tier #4 bracket pegs at 60° and 120°

7b. Snap track_seg_02 → track_seg_13 together in ascending order: each segment's uphill end has Twin Ø3.80×5.0 mm Under-Shoulder Male Snap-Lock Tenon Pegs (u = ±14.2 mm, v = -4.2 mm, with Ø4.08 mm detent rings) + Inner/Outer Sidewall Anti-Torsion Tongues that click directly into the next segment's Ø4.30×5.6 mm Female Sockets, while the even-60° cantilever brackets lock into the underside seam sockets!
7c. Dock track_seg_14_top_entry into Trunk_Top's -Y discharge chute (Z = 431.4 mm) and snap its downhill socket onto track_seg_13's male tenon pegs at 1560°.
assembly_steps.clearance_note: Every track seam locks in 3D via Twin Ø3.8mm Under-Shoulder Snap-Tenons + Sidewall Anti-Torsion Tongues (0.000 mm³ collision, 84.1 mm³ shear lock) and Even-60° Underside Seam Bracket Sockets!

assembly_steps.title: Step 8 — Snap In BTF-LIGHTING DC5V WS2812B Pebble/Seed Pixel Wire (B0CCS11V7H) & Connect to Grove GPIO26 + WAGO-3/4
assembly_steps.subtitle: 8a) Seat B0CCS11V7H starter pocket under track_seg_01 → 8b) Snap 50-LED Pebble wire into 4.6mm dovetail throat up Seg 01→14 → 8c) Connect Data to GPIO26 & Power to 5V Buck (WAGO-3/4)
hardware: 8a. Seat the starter end of the BTF-LIGHTING DC5V WS2812B Pebble/Seed Pixel Flexible Wire (B0CCS11V7H) into the 10.0×16.0 mm starter pocket underneath track_seg_01 (theta = -70°)

8b. Press the 360°-flexible 3-wire cord and 6.2×3.2 mm oval Pebble LEDs through the 4.6 mm snap-in throat into the 8.0×3.6 mm internal dovetail chamber all the way up to Segment 14 (zero glue or tape needed!)

8c. Route the pre-terminated 3-pin JST-SM input plug (and power-injection pigtails) through Trunk_Base's cob_wire_conduit into the Hollow Root Vault: connect White Data to Grove GPIO26 and clamp Red (+5V) / Black (GND) into WAGO-3 (+5V_LED) & WAGO-4 (GND_LED) fed by the dedicated 12V→5V 5A buck converter
assembly_steps.clearance_note: The track's 8.0×3.6 mm underside dovetail chamber has a 4.6 mm snap-in throat (with 45° self-supporting retention lips) that mechanically locks both the 6.2 mm oval Pebble LEDs and 3-wire cord in place with zero glue or tape.

assembly_steps.title: Step 9 — Thread Topper Cable Through 10×8mm Conduit, Snap On Conduit_Cover_Strip & Seat Apple Topper (#4)
assembly_steps.subtitle: 9a) Thread pre-terminated JST-SM plug straight through 10×8mm rear (-X) conduit to GPIO32 & WAGO-3/4 → 9b) Seat Sparkleiot 16-Bit Ring → 9c) Place Apple Topper (#4)
hardware: 9a. Thread the pre-terminated 1m 3-Pin JST-SM Extension Cable (B0CT827QQC) straight down the oversized 10.0×8.0 mm rear (-X) Connector-Pass-Through conduit into the Hollow Root Vault (connect Center Data to Grove Yellow GPIO32 and +5V/GND to WAGO-3 & WAGO-4), then press-fit the brown Conduit_Cover_Strip flush into the groove
9b. Seat the Ø45.0 mm Sparkleiot 16-Bit WS2812 RGB LED Ring (B09YTMNGTD) flat into the Ø46.2×2.5 mm recessed ring seat on the top rim of Trunk_Top (#3 at Z = 447.5 mm)

9c. Lower the Sculpted Heart-Shaped Crimson Apple Topper (#4, with Woody Stem & Emerald Leaf) onto Trunk_Top's upward Ø59.40×4.0 mm Crown Centering Tenon Collar (which telescopes inside the topper's Ø60.00 mm base socket with 0.30 mm radial clearance so the topper locks concentrically onto the trunk!)
assembly_steps.clearance_note: The upgraded 10.0 mm wide × 8.0 mm deep rear (-X) conduit lets pre-terminated JST-SM, PH2.0, SH1.0, and Dupont plugs pass straight through without cutting or de-pinning wires!

assembly_steps.title: Step 10 — Insert 8 Magnetic Switch LEDs Into Upgraded 4-Color Planets #8 → #1 & Snap-Click Onto Balconies
assembly_steps.subtitle: For each larger 4-color sculpted planet (#8 Neptune at bottom to #1 Mercury at top): insert its wireless Magnetic Switch LED and snap-click onto Balcony Peg #8 → #1
hardware: 10a. Press 1× wireless Bambu Single LED Magnetic Control Switch Light (Ø7.5×6.0 mm) through the 45° self-centering entry funnel into the upper Ø8.0×6.0 mm LED chamber of each Planet (#8 Neptune → #1 Mercury)

10b. Match the hidden number inside each planet's bottom bore (8..1) with the number engraved on top of each Track Balcony Peg (8..1) and press down until the internal Ø8.44 mm detent groove clicks onto the peg's Ø8.12 mm snap bead
assembly_steps.clearance_note: Each upgraded 4-color planet is 40–55% larger in diameter with an integrated Ø13.6 mm Orbital Pedestal Foot Collar that raises the globe and rings above the track wall and rolling marbles (0.000 mm³ collision!).

assembly_steps.title: Step 11 — Assemble Magic_LED_Wand & Dock in +30° Root-Flare Holster
assembly_steps.subtitle: Press the Ø8×2 mm trigger magnet into the Magic_LED_Wand star tip and stand the wand upright in the +30° Root-Flare Holster
hardware: 11a. Press the included Ø8×2 mm neodymium trigger magnet into the star tip of the 3-color Magic_LED_Wand
11b. Dock the wand upright in the integrated +30° Root-Flare Holster socket (X = +45.0, Y = +26.0 mm) on Trunk_Base
assembly_steps.clearance_note: Touching any planet with the Magic_LED_Wand star tip toggles its internal magnetic reed switch through ON -> Breathe -> Flash -> OFF.

assembly_steps.title: Step 12 — Twist-Lock the 6 Glowing Apple Marbles (A + Bambu Y-Shape or Single LED + B) & Run!
assembly_steps.subtitle: Drop a Bambu Y-Shape LED Light (Ø18×6.5 mm KC012/KC013) or Single LED + M8 nut into Apple_Hemisphere_B, align & drop Apple_Hemisphere_A into the 3 keyways, twist 45° clockwise to lock, and tap ON with the Magic Wand!
hardware: 12a. Drop 1× wireless Bambu Y-Shape LED Light with Magnetic Control Switch (Ø18.0×6.5 mm KC012/KC013, CR1632 battery) OR 1× Single LED (Ø7.5×6.0 mm KA006) + M8 Hex Nut into the Ø18.70 mm chamber of Apple_Hemisphere_B (marked 'B')
12b. Align the 3 male bayonet lugs on Apple_Hemisphere_A (marked 'A') with the 3 vertical entry keyway slots on Apple_Hemisphere_B—the two halves drop flush together with zero force
12c. Twist Apple_Hemisphere_A 45° clockwise ('righty-tighty') to lock the 3 lugs under the solid bayonet ceiling, tap each marble ON with the Magic_LED_Wand, and load onto the track!
assembly_steps.clearance_note: The Quarter-Turn 3-Lug Bayonet Twist-Lock requires zero PLA bending to insert (+0.44 mm clearance) and locks under solid PLA ceilings so the halves never separate during rolling or drops!
